reference_precedence: Target modeled camera > companion modeled view > Amy style board

jobs.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic interior design visualization, landscape, based on the references. Reference 1 is the authoritative target 3D modeled camera and layout; reference 2 is the SAME ROOM from the opposite angle, supplied for spatial consistency only; reference 3 is Amy Wu's style/design board, supplied for selected furniture appearance, fabrics, colors and finishes only. Reproduce reference 1's framing, vanishing points, ceiling height, wall outline, column centers, openings, furniture silhouettes/footprints, rotations, quantities and exact relative distances. The apartment is compact: do not expand it, widen aisles, move furniture, mirror the layout, invent doors/windows, or replace its architecture with the board composition. Upgrade the rough model materials and simplified proxy surfaces to plausible realistic versions of the board items. Keep all existing measured architectural boundaries, foreground crop and occlusions. Use soft balanced physically plausible illumination and a natural architectural camera; no words, labels, borders or collage. Basement living/dining: preserve the low white ceiling and long lowered soffit, white rectangular support columns, gray plank floor, exact staircase footprint/step direction and blonde wood stair surfaces, compact kitchen fixtures at the far end, and all fixed openings. Upholstery is ivory/beige boucle on the sofa with a scalloped/channel back; orange/rust boucle tub swivel chairs with low black disc bases; round black marble nesting coffee tables with restrained pale veins; white/ivory rug with bold irregular continuous black lines; warm solid oak dining table with SIX camel/beige upholstered dining chairs with slender black legs; natural wood side table with a black small lamp. The side-wall artwork is a black framed orange sunlit-window image as in Amy's board, but is art, never an actual window. Dark sepia curtain is the existing bedroom divider at the same position, not a new window. Keep all black circular table footprints as modeled. Selected furniture stays exactly where the model places it. No additional furniture. TARGET A: stairs and support columns on the LEFT; two orange chairs in the near CENTER/RIGHT foreground looking inward toward the partially cropped sofa at lower LEFT; nesting tables/rug cropped at bottom; SIX-seat dining table across the room behind chairs; compact kitchen on the far wall. Retain the exact diagonal perspective, do not center the dining table in the image or widen the aisle.
